article.title: Rubio, France’s student uprising, and the politics of ethnic cleansing in Europe
article.author: Ajamu Baraka
article.content: Marco Rubio's speeches invoking a shared Western civilization are part of the ideological consolidation of fascism, mobilizing white racial solidarity to defend a declining capitalist order. The post Rubio, France’s student uprising, and the politics of ethnic cleansing in Europe appeared first on MR Online .
